name: speccy
description: An elegant OpenAPI reference renderer for the web, macOS, and Docusaurus.

scripts.build: npm run build -w speccy-core && npm run build -w speccy-spectral && npm run build -w speccy-cli && npm run build -w speccy-renderer && npm run build -w docusaurus-plugin-speccy && npm run build -w @speccy/web && npm run build -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo && npm run build -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.test: npm run test:action && npm run test -w speccy-core && npm run test -w speccy-spectral && npm run test -w speccy-cli && npm run test -w speccy-renderer && npm run test -w docusaurus-plugin-speccy && npm run test -w @speccy/web && npm run test -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w speccy-core && npm run build -w speccy-renderer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w speccy-core && npm run typecheck -w speccy-spectral && npm run typecheck -w speccy-cli && npm run typecheck -w speccy-renderer && npm run typecheck -w docusaurus-plugin-speccy && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/web && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo && npm run typecheck -w create-speccy-reference
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
